description: This file contains an abstract assertion class for verifying properties of ThingQueryCommand instances within a testing framework. It uses AssertJ for assertions and is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, focusing on command assertions related to 'things'.

classes.name: AbstractThingQueryCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class providing assertion methods for ThingQueryCommand objects, enabling fluent testing of command properties.

methods.name: withSelectedFields
methods.description: Asserts that the command's selected fields match the expected fields, handling null expectations appropriately.
